catalogue: Australian domestic wet-area construction and waterproofing

objects.name: wet-area waterproofing system
objects.definition: A coordinated set of substrates, membranes or water-resistant materials, junction treatments, flashings, seals, drainage connections and finishes that protects building elements around showers, baths, basins, laundries and similar internal wet areas.
functions: Prevent unwanted water escape
Direct water to suitable drainage
Keep junctions and penetrations continuous with protected wall and floor fields

ncc_references.relationship: Wet areas may use the complete Housing Provisions Part 10.2 path or the stated Housing Provisions clauses together with AS 3740:2021.

cad.pattern: Connected protected floor and wall fields around wet-area fixtures
cad.placement: Between structural construction and exposed finishes or as an approved exposed waterproof surface
cad.opening: Turns continuously into drains, doorways, junctions and sealed penetrations
cad.load: Non-structural moisture-control assembly supported by building substrates

notes: Waterproof and water resistant describe different required performance in the NCC; the model keeps both rather than colouring the whole room as one membrane.

objects.name: wet-area floor assembly
objects.definition: The complete floor build-up in a bathroom, shower room, laundry, sanitary compartment or similar wet area, from structural support through substrate, falls, protection layers and finished walking surface to drainage and perimeter junctions.
functions: Support wet-area use and finishes
Provide required falls where a floor waste is installed
Connect floor protection to walls, openings and drains

cad.pattern: Room floor divided into drainage planes and protected fields
cad.placement: Over structural floor framing or slab
cad.opening: Contains drains, penetrations and fixture footprints
cad.load: Supports finishes and occupancy through the substrate

objects.name: wet-area wall assembly
objects.definition: The complete protected wall build-up in a wet area, including framing or masonry, sheet or rendered substrate, membranes and junction treatments where required, and the exposed tiled, sheet or panel finish.
functions: Support wet-area finishes and fittings
Resist or stop water according to the protected field
Connect wall protection around corners, floors and penetrations

cad.pattern: Protected wall fields bounded by room corners and fixture extents
cad.placement: On framing, masonry or concrete wall construction
cad.opening: Wraps or seals service penetrations and recesses
cad.load: Supports finishes and fittings through the wall substrate

objects.name: tiled wet-area floor assembly
objects.definition: A wet-area floor build-up finished with floor tiles bonded to a compatible tile bed, screed, membrane or prepared substrate and completed with grout, flexible joints, trims and drainage interfaces.
functions: Provide a durable walking finish
Follow the designed fall planes
Protect the underlying waterproofing from normal use

cad.pattern: Repeated tiles cut to room boundaries, falls and drains
cad.placement: Over the completed protected floor build-up
cad.opening: Cut around wastes and penetrations without flattening fall planes
cad.load: Finish loads transferred through adhesive and substrate

notes: Tiles and grout are water-resistant finishes in the Housing Provisions path; they do not replace required waterproof junctions or membranes.

objects.name: tiled wet-area wall assembly
objects.definition: A wet-area wall build-up finished with wall tiles bonded to a prepared substrate or membrane and completed with grout, flexible changes of plane, trims and sealed fixture penetrations.
functions: Provide a cleanable wall finish
Protect the substrate from direct splash as part of the system
Coordinate tile joints with corners, fixtures and openings

cad.pattern: Repeated tile courses over protected wall fields
cad.placement: On a suitable wall substrate or compatible membrane
cad.opening: Cut and sealed around fixtures, niches and openings
cad.load: Tile weight transferred through adhesive to substrate

objects.name: shower area waterproofing assembly
objects.definition: The protected floor, walls, junctions, penetrations and drainage components within the defined shower area, coordinated with its screen or open edge and with a hob, stepdown or level threshold.
functions: Contain shower water
Direct water to the shower floor waste
Keep wall, floor and penetration protection continuous

ncc_references.relationship: Defines protected shower surfaces and requires a floor waste plus a stepdown, hob or level threshold in the full Housing Provisions path.

cad.pattern: Protected three-dimensional zone centred on shower use and bounded by screen, walls or prescribed extent
cad.placement: Within a bathroom or shower room
cad.opening: Includes screen opening and sealed service penetrations
cad.load: Non-structural enclosure and water-control assembly

objects.name: enclosed shower waterproofing assembly
objects.definition: A shower area whose water-spray boundary is defined by walls and a shower screen or door, with its floor and edge construction coordinated to keep water inside the enclosure.
functions: Contain spray within the enclosure
Define the shower-area edge
Coordinate the screen with hob, stepdown or waterstop

cad.pattern: Shower zone bounded by walls and screen line
cad.placement: Within a wet-area floor
cad.load: Screen and finishes supported by their substrates

objects.name: unenclosed shower waterproofing assembly
objects.definition: A shower area without a complete screen enclosure, so its protected floor extent and waterstop boundary are established from the shower outlet and surrounding wet-area construction.
functions: Contain and drain water without a complete screen
Define the outer protected floor boundary
Connect the shower field to the rest of the wet-area floor

cad.pattern: Open shower field with explicit outer waterstop or whole-floor protection boundary
cad.placement: Within bathroom floor
cad.load: Floor and wall water-control assembly

notes: Walk-in describes access experience and does not by itself prove that the shower is unenclosed or level-threshold.

objects.name: shower-with-hob assembly
objects.definition: A shower assembly whose entry or perimeter includes a raised water-retaining hob covered by the waterproofing system and coordinated with the shower screen.
functions: Provide a raised water boundary
Support or align the shower screen
Carry the membrane continuously over the shower edge
materials: masonry, concrete, AAC or foam hob

cad.pattern: Raised continuous edge along shower entry or perimeter
cad.placement: On shower floor substrate before finishes
cad.opening: Entry passes over the finished hob
cad.load: Supports screen only where the selected detail permits

objects.name: stepdown shower assembly
objects.definition: A shower assembly whose finished shower floor is set lower than the finished floor outside the shower, creating a vertical edge at the enclosure boundary instead of a raised hob.
functions: Create a level difference that helps retain water
Provide space for falls and finishes
Align screen and membrane with the step edge

cad.pattern: Lower shower floor plane separated by vertical step face
cad.placement: Within structural slab or framed-floor build-up
cad.load: Floor build-up supported by lowered structural or sheet substrate

notes: Store structural set-down, screed and finished step separately; one may exist without the others matching exactly.

objects.name: level-threshold shower assembly
objects.definition: A shower assembly whose access edge has no raised hob or finished step, using falls, a waterstop and the screen or open-edge detail to define the shower boundary.
functions: Provide step-free shower access
Terminate the shower membrane at a controlled boundary
Coordinate waterstop, screen and adjacent floor levels

cad.pattern: Continuous access plane with distinct fall planes and waterstop line
cad.placement: At shower entry
cad.opening: No raised obstruction at access line
cad.load: Floor finishes supported continuously

notes: Level threshold describes the finished access edge, not a flat shower floor; the floor still falls to its waste under the Housing Provisions path.

objects.name: preformed shower base assembly
objects.definition: A factory-made shower base installed as the shower floor and tray, including its formed falls, waste opening, perimeter upturn lip, support and waterproof connections to wall materials and drainage.
functions: Form and waterproof the shower floor
Direct water to the waste opening
Provide an upturned edge behind wall materials

cad.pattern: One factory-shaped tray with perimeter lip and waste recess
cad.placement: On prepared floor support and recessed at adjacent walls
cad.opening: Contains factory or approved waste opening
cad.load: Supported continuously or at documented support points

objects.name: in-situ shower tray assembly
objects.definition: A site-formed waterproof shower-floor tray created by applying membrane across the shower floor, up adjacent walls and into its drain and edge terminations before the surface finish is installed.
functions: Create a continuous site-formed shower pan
Connect floor membrane to walls and drain
Support a tiled or other compatible finish
attributes: membrane position above or below screed

cad.pattern: Continuous membrane tray folded or coated across floor and wall upturns
cad.placement: Over or below the shower screed according to system
cad.load: Non-structural membrane supported by prepared substrate

objects.name: bath or spa surround waterproofing assembly
objects.definition: The protected wall, floor, shelf, lip, junction and penetration construction immediately around a bath or spa, coordinated with whether the vessel is freestanding, abutting a wall or inserted into a surround.
functions: Protect building surfaces from splash and overflow
Seal vessel-to-wall and shelf junctions
Waterproof tap and spout penetrations where required

cad.pattern: Protected fields following bath or spa perimeter and adjacent walls
cad.placement: Around and beneath selected vessel interfaces
cad.opening: Sealed around taps, spouts and wastes
cad.load: Vessel supported separately from waterproof finishes unless documented

objects.name: inserted bath or spa assembly
objects.definition: A bath or spa vessel set into a framed, masonry or proprietary surround so an adjoining horizontal shelf meets the vessel lip and the surrounding wall and waterproofing layers turn down inside its upturn.
functions: Support an inset vessel
Form waterproof horizontal shelf interfaces
Connect the wall substrate and waterstop to the vessel upturn

cad.pattern: Vessel nested inside a supporting surround and shelf
cad.placement: Against or between wet-area walls
cad.opening: Includes access, waste and tap openings
cad.load: Vessel weight carried by its documented supports

objects.name: wet-area doorway waterproofing termination
objects.definition: The coordinated end of a waterproof or water-resistant floor system at a doorway, including the membrane termination, waterstop, perimeter flashing, door-jamb treatment and finished floor transition.
functions: Stop water leaving through the doorway build-up
Join membrane and perimeter flashing
Protect door-jamb ends and floor transition

ncc_references.relationship: Coordinates floor-level opening waterstops, perimeter flashings and door-jamb waterproofing.

cad.pattern: One continuous transverse termination across each protected doorway
cad.placement: At wet-area floor opening
cad.opening: Crosses the door opening while maintaining finished access level
cad.load: Non-structural water-control junction

objects.name: membrane-to-drainage connection
objects.definition: The waterproof junction where a floor or shower membrane terminates into or onto a drainage flange, preformed tray outlet or compatible drainage riser so water reaching the membrane level can enter the drain.
functions: Seal membrane to the drain
Collect water at membrane level
Coordinate tile-bed thickness and waste height

ncc_references.relationship: Requires a waterproof membrane termination to the drainage flange, tray or riser.

cad.pattern: Concentric or linear membrane termination around drain throat
cad.placement: At the low point of protected floor planes
cad.opening: Preserves the drainage opening and any tile-bed drainage path
cad.load: Drain fitting supported by substrate and pipework

objects.name: wet-area floor substrate
objects.definition: The stable floor surface that receives a wet-area membrane, screed, sheet finish, adhesive or other protective layer and transfers its loads to the structural floor.
functions: Support waterproofing and finishes
Provide a clean continuous application surface
Carry floor and fixture loads to structure

cad.pattern: Continuous floor field or supported sheet layout
cad.placement: Over slab or floor framing
cad.opening: Cut and supported around wastes and penetrations
cad.load: Substrate supporting protection and finishes

objects.name: wet-area wall substrate
objects.definition: The wall surface or lining that supports a wet-area membrane, tile adhesive, sheet finish or other protection and transfers finish and fitting loads to wall framing or masonry.
functions: Support waterproofing and wall finishes
Provide a stable plane around fixtures and openings
Receive sealed joints and penetrations

cad.pattern: Continuous wall field assembled from sheets, render, masonry or concrete
cad.placement: On wall framing or solid wall
cad.opening: Cut, supported and sealed around services and niches
cad.load: Carries finish and fitting loads to wall structure

objects.name: concrete wet-area substrate
objects.definition: A concrete slab, wall or topping surface prepared to receive wet-area protection, screed, adhesive or finish, with cracks, joints, penetrations and falls resolved before covering.
functions: Provide rigid support
Receive membrane or water-resistant treatment
Form or support floor falls and set-downs

cad.pattern: Continuous cast surface with explicit joints, recesses and drain openings
cad.placement: As floor or wall construction
cad.load: Structural or topping support as separately designed

objects.name: cement-render wet-area wall substrate
objects.definition: A cement-based render layer applied over masonry or another suitable wall background to create a firm, aligned wet-area substrate for treatment, membrane, adhesive or finish.
functions: Level and true the wall surface
Provide a cementitious receiving surface
Bridge the solid wall background to finishes

cad.pattern: Continuous levelling layer over solid wall background
cad.placement: Between masonry or concrete and membrane or tiling
cad.load: Supports adhered finish through bond to wall

objects.name: compressed fibre-cement wet-area floor sheet
objects.definition: A dense compressed fibre-cement sheet supported on structural flooring or framing to form a water-resistant wet-area floor substrate for membranes, screeds, sheet finishes or tiles.
functions: Provide a stable wet-area floor substrate
Span between documented supports
Receive joints, fixings and waterproofing

cad.pattern: Staggered or system-defined sheets over floor supports
cad.placement: On structural floor framing or floor substrate
cad.opening: Cut and supported around wastes and fixtures
cad.load: Floor-substrate loads transferred to framing

objects.name: fibre-cement wet-area wall sheet
objects.definition: A fibre-cement lining sheet fixed to wall framing or a suitable support as a water-resistant wet-area substrate for membranes, tiles or other finishes.
functions: Line wet-area wall framing
Provide a stable tile or membrane substrate
Receive joints, fixings and sealed penetrations

cad.pattern: Full-height or horizontally jointed sheets on stud framing
cad.placement: On wet-area wall frame or furring
cad.opening: Cut, supported and sealed around fixtures and niches
cad.load: Finish loads transferred through sheet fixings to frame

objects.name: water-resistant plasterboard wet-area lining
objects.definition: A gypsum plasterboard manufactured with water-resistant properties and used as a wet-area wall substrate within the locations and protection system permitted for the selected product.
functions: Line wet-area wall framing
Receive tiles or approved finishes
Provide a lightweight water-resistant substrate

cad.pattern: Plasterboard sheets fixed to wet-area wall framing
cad.placement: Within permitted water-resistant or waterproofed wall zones
cad.load: Finish loads transferred through lining to frame

notes: Water-resistant plasterboard is not itself a universally waterproof material; cut edges and required shower zones still need the specified protection.

objects.name: wet-area substrate sheet joint
objects.definition: The product-specific joint between adjacent wet-area floor or wall substrate sheets, including the required gap, adhesive, sealant, tape, compound, edge engagement and supporting framing.
functions: Join adjacent substrate sheets
Maintain a stable finish plane
Provide the specified base for membrane and surface finishes

cad.pattern: Continuous line along adjacent sheet edges
cad.placement: Over supporting framing or system-defined edge
cad.load: Transfers or accommodates sheet-edge actions as product specifies

objects.name: wet-area substrate fixing
objects.definition: A corrosion-compatible screw, nail or other approved fastener securing wet-area sheet substrate to framing or support, with penetrations treated as required by the waterproofing system.
functions: Fix substrate sheet to support
Transfer finish and sheet loads
Maintain the scheduled fixing pattern

cad.pattern: Repeated fixing points following sheet and frame layout
cad.placement: Through sheet into support
cad.opening: Creates a penetration requiring system treatment where exposed
cad.load: Transfers sheet and finish loads to support

objects.name: wet-area lining cut-edge seal
objects.definition: A compatible waterproof coating, sealant or membrane treatment applied to exposed cut edges of a wet-area lining where moisture or capillary action could enter the sheet.
functions: Stop water entering a cut sheet edge
Continue the protected wall field around openings
Protect bottom edges above shower bases and floors

cad.pattern: Narrow continuous treatment on specified sheet cuts
cad.placement: At lower edges, penetrations, niches and exposed cuts
cad.load: Non-structural moisture seal

objects.name: wet-area substrate levelling compound
objects.definition: A compatible cementitious or resin-modified material used locally or continuously to fill depressions, remove abrupt irregularities and create a suitable surface before membrane or tiling work.
functions: Fill surface imperfections
Create an even application plane
Provide a compatible base for later layers

cad.pattern: Local patches or continuous thin levelling field
cad.placement: On prepared substrate before waterproofing
cad.opening: Keeps drain and movement joints clear
cad.load: Non-structural surface preparation layer

objects.name: wet-area membrane primer
objects.definition: A product-specific liquid coating applied to a prepared substrate to control suction, improve adhesion or otherwise condition the surface for the selected wet-area membrane.
functions: Prepare substrate for membrane adhesion
Control porous-surface absorption
Form part of the selected membrane system
materials: polymer dispersion or other compatible primer

cad.pattern: Thin continuous coating over membrane application field
cad.placement: Directly on prepared substrate
cad.opening: Coats around penetrations without blocking drains
cad.load: Non-structural adhesion layer

notes: Primer is product-specific; a future tool must not invent one universal primer beneath every membrane.

objects.name: wet-area fall-forming screed
objects.definition: A site-laid cementitious or proprietary layer shaped into continuous planes that create the required fall from wet-area floor boundaries toward a floor waste or shower drain.
functions: Form drainage falls
Provide a stable surface for membrane or tiles
Adjust levels around set-downs and wastes

cad.pattern: Triangulated or planar sloping fields converging on drain edges
cad.placement: Above structural substrate and above or below membrane according to system
cad.load: Supports membrane or tile finish

notes: Fall is geometry and screed is material; a slab can form falls without screed, and a screed may also serve as a tile bed.

objects.name: wet-area tile bed
objects.definition: A mortar or proprietary bedding layer beneath floor tiles that establishes their level and fall, supports the tiled finish and interfaces with the membrane and drainage fitting.
functions: Support floor tiles
Transfer finish loads
Carry water reaching the bed toward a compatible drain where the system provides for it

cad.pattern: Continuous mortar field beneath floor tiles
cad.placement: Above or below membrane according to selected assembly
cad.opening: Accommodates drain body and tile-bed drainage
cad.load: Supports tiled finish

objects.name: shower hob
objects.definition: A raised continuous kerb at a shower boundary, securely fixed and made flush before waterproofing so membrane and finishes can pass over it and the screen can align on the shower side.
functions: Retain water at the shower edge
Provide a formed boundary for membrane and finishes
Support or locate screen components where detailed

cad.pattern: Continuous raised member along shower edge
cad.placement: Fixed to shower floor substrate
cad.opening: Entry crosses over the finished hob
cad.load: Non-structural water-retaining member unless screen support is documented

notes: The full Housing Provisions path lists acceptable hob substrate families; timber is not treated as a generic hob material.

objects.name: shower floor stepdown
objects.definition: The formed change in level between the floor outside a shower and the lower shower floor, including its horizontal break line and finished vertical face.
functions: Create a lower shower floor zone
Help contain water
Provide a boundary for screen and waterproofing details

cad.pattern: Continuous level-break line at shower boundary
cad.placement: Between bathroom and shower floor planes
cad.load: Part of floor build-up rather than a separate structural member automatically

objects.name: wet-area waterstop angle
objects.definition: A corrosion-resistant angle or upstand fixed at a shower edge, doorway or other floor boundary so the membrane can seal to its vertical leg and terminate the protected floor field.
functions: Form a physical water barrier at floor level
Provide a membrane termination face
Define shower or room waterproofing extent

cad.pattern: Continuous angle along shower or doorway boundary
cad.placement: Directly on floor substrate beneath finishes
cad.opening: Crosses or bounds the floor opening
cad.load: Non-structural membrane termination and water barrier

notes: Tiling angle can also describe decorative tile trim; role, position and membrane bond must resolve the object.

objects.name: wet-area waterproofing membrane
objects.definition: A continuous flexible or elastomeric barrier installed over a prepared wet-area substrate and joined to flashings, drains, penetrations and terminations to stop water passing into the building fabric.
functions: Form a waterproof barrier
Bridge compatible junction movement with bond-breaker detailing
Connect protected fields to drains and waterstops

cad.pattern: Continuous bounded surface with laps, turns and penetrations
cad.placement: On prepared substrate above or below screed according to assembly
cad.load: Non-structural barrier bonded or mechanically restrained to substrate

objects.name: liquid-applied wet-area membrane
objects.definition: A wet-applied coating system that cures into a continuous waterproof membrane across prepared floors, walls, corners and details, normally built up in one or more coats with compatible accessories.
functions: Form a seamless waterproof field
Conform to corners and penetrations
Bond continuously to the prepared substrate

cad.pattern: One or more coincident coating fields with reinforced detail zones
cad.placement: Directly on primed or prepared substrate
cad.opening: Turns tightly around collars, flanges and penetrations
cad.load: Bonded flexible barrier

notes: Model dry installed membrane geometry; wet coat thickness and coverage remain product and inspection data.

objects.name: sheet-applied wet-area membrane
objects.definition: A factory-manufactured waterproof sheet installed over wet-area substrates with bonded, welded or otherwise sealed laps, corners and penetrations.
functions: Provide a controlled factory-made membrane thickness
Cover wet-area fields
Join sheets into a continuous waterproof barrier

cad.pattern: Roll-width sheets with explicit lap and corner geometry
cad.placement: Bonded or fixed to prepared wet-area substrate
cad.opening: Uses collars or formed patches around penetrations
cad.load: Flexible barrier supported by substrate

objects.name: internal-face wet-area membrane system
objects.definition: A wet-area membrane arrangement installed on the room-facing side of the wall or floor substrate directly beneath the tiled or other compatible finish.
functions: Stop water near the exposed finish
Protect substrate and framing behind it
Connect directly to room-side drains and terminations
not_synonyms: external waterproofing to a building wall

cad.pattern: Continuous membrane immediately behind exposed finish
cad.placement: On room-facing substrate surface
cad.load: Non-structural bonded barrier

notes: Internal describes the membrane's position relative to the substrate and room, not whether the bathroom is inside the building.

objects.name: external-to-substrate wet-area membrane system
objects.definition: A wet-area membrane or tray arrangement positioned behind a wall lining or other substrate layer rather than directly on its room-facing finish side, with flashings and overlaps directing water back to the protected floor or vessel.
functions: Provide a concealed water barrier behind substrate or lining
Collect water that passes the inner layer
Lap into floor waterproofing, shower base or bath junctions

cad.pattern: Concealed membrane field behind lining or render
cad.placement: Outside the room-facing substrate layer but within wet-area wall build-up
cad.load: Non-structural concealed barrier

notes: The word external is highly context-sensitive; future UI should display behind-lining position rather than the short label alone.

objects.name: waterproof flexible sheet wet-area flooring
objects.definition: A flexible sheet floor finish whose material and sealed seams form the required waterproof surface, turned or joined into walls, drains and penetrations as a complete wet-area system.
functions: Provide the exposed walking finish
Form a waterproof surface and sealed joint network
Turn into coves and compatible floor wastes
materials: rubber or other waterproof resilient sheet

cad.pattern: Roll-width finish sheets with welded or sealed seams and coved edges
cad.placement: On prepared wet-area floor substrate
cad.opening: Heat-formed or sealed around compatible fittings
cad.load: Walking finish adhered to substrate

notes: Waterproof and merely water-resistant sheet flooring remain different system classes.

objects.name: waterproof flexible-sheet joint
objects.definition: A welded, bonded or otherwise sealed seam joining adjacent waterproof flexible floor or wall sheets so the surface remains continuous through the joint.
functions: Join flexible sheets
Maintain waterproof continuity
Accommodate the selected sheet system and service conditions

cad.pattern: Continuous seam between adjacent flexible sheets
cad.placement: Within the sheet-finish field
cad.load: Seals the finish joint

objects.name: wet-area membrane reinforcement
objects.definition: A compatible fabric, mesh or tape embedded within a liquid-applied membrane at the whole field or selected corners, joints and penetrations to strengthen the cured membrane and control local movement.
functions: Reinforce membrane across details
Control coating thickness and continuity
Bridge compatible joints and changes of plane

cad.pattern: Full-field mesh or narrow strips at detail zones
cad.placement: Embedded between wet membrane coats
cad.load: Reinforces flexible barrier rather than structure

objects.name: preformed membrane corner band
objects.definition: A flexible factory-made strip installed across wall/floor, wall/wall or other changes of plane and bonded into the adjoining membrane fields to form a continuous waterproof corner.
functions: Waterproof changes of plane
Bridge the corner over a compatible bond breaker
Join adjacent membrane fields

cad.pattern: Continuous folded strip along change of plane
cad.placement: Between adjoining membrane fields
cad.opening: Uses formed pieces at intersecting corners
cad.load: Flexible waterproof corner connector

objects.name: wet-area membrane penetration collar
objects.definition: A flexible preformed or site-cut membrane patch that fits around a pipe, mixer body or other penetration and bonds into the surrounding wall or floor membrane.
functions: Seal membrane around a penetration
Bridge movement between service and substrate
Provide a controlled lap into the main membrane

cad.pattern: Annular or shaped patch around each protected penetration
cad.placement: Bonded into membrane field
cad.load: Non-structural flexible seal

objects.name: wet-area membrane bond breaker
objects.definition: A compatible strip, fillet or backing element placed at a change of plane or movement joint so a bonded membrane does not adhere across the full corner and can flex over movement without excessive local strain.
functions: Prevent membrane bonding at the movement line
Create a flexible membrane bridge
Match the movement capacity of the selected membrane class

ncc_references.relationship: Bond breakers are installed at bonded-membrane wall/wall, wall/floor, hob/wall and movement joints and matched to membrane flexibility.

cad.pattern: Continuous narrow run along changes of plane and movement joints
cad.placement: Between prepared substrate and membrane
cad.load: Movement-control interface, not structural support

objects.name: bond-breaker tape
objects.definition: A narrow non-bonding or one-sided tape applied along a wet-area junction so the membrane bridges the tape instead of adhering directly to the movement line.
functions: Create a non-adhered membrane strip
Set the bond-breaker width
Follow straight and curved junction routes

cad.pattern: Continuous narrow tape centred on junction
cad.placement: Under membrane along movement line
cad.load: Non-bonding interface

objects.name: bond-breaker sealant fillet
objects.definition: A compatible triangular or concave flexible sealant fillet formed in a wet-area corner before membrane application so the membrane turns across a smooth non-sharp movement zone.
functions: Round the change of plane
Provide the designed bond-breaker geometry
Support membrane movement through the corner

cad.pattern: Continuous triangular or radiused bead in corner
cad.placement: At substrate change of plane below membrane
cad.load: Flexible membrane-supporting fillet

objects.name: bond-breaker backing rod
objects.definition: A compressible round foam rod placed in a wet-area joint or corner to set a curved non-bonding surface beneath the membrane or compatible sealant.
functions: Create a rounded bond-breaker surface
Control joint depth
Allow membrane or sealant movement

cad.pattern: Continuous cylindrical run within corner or joint
cad.placement: Below membrane or sealant bridge
cad.load: Compressible bond-breaker support

objects.name: wet-area perimeter flashing
objects.definition: A continuous waterproof flashing turned up the wall and across the floor substrate at a wet-area wall/floor junction, connected to membrane fields, waterstops and doorway terminations.
functions: Waterproof the wall-to-floor junction
Turn floor protection up the wall
Connect perimeter protection to openings and vertical flashings

cad.pattern: Continuous L-shaped route around protected floor perimeter
cad.placement: At wall/floor substrate junction beneath finishes
cad.load: Non-structural waterproof junction

objects.name: internal vertical wet-area flashing
objects.definition: A vertical waterproof strip installed on the room-facing side of wall substrate at a shower corner or wall junction and overlapped by adjoining membrane, lining or finish layers.
functions: Waterproof vertical junctions
Join adjoining room-side protected wall fields
Continue protection upward from floor or shower tray

cad.pattern: Continuous vertical folded strip at wall junction
cad.placement: On room-facing substrate beneath membrane or finish
cad.load: Non-structural waterproof corner

objects.name: behind-lining vertical wet-area flashing
objects.definition: A vertical waterproof strip installed behind wall sheeting or render at a wet-area junction, with legs lapped by the substrate layers and its lower end connected into the floor protection, shower base or bath junction.
functions: Waterproof a concealed vertical junction
Collect water behind lining
Lap concealed wall protection into lower drainage or vessel details

cad.pattern: Continuous concealed vertical strip at wall junction
cad.placement: Behind lining or render
cad.load: Non-structural concealed waterproof junction

objects.name: bath or spa lip waterstop
objects.definition: A waterproof angle or upstand installed beneath the lip of an inserted bath or spa so the adjoining waterproof shelf or wall system terminates against the vessel without allowing water behind the surround.
functions: Stop water at the vessel lip
Connect shelf membrane to the bath or spa
Protect the concealed surround below

cad.pattern: Continuous angle beneath vessel lip
cad.placement: Between inserted bath or spa and waterproof shelf
cad.load: Non-structural waterstop

objects.name: shower-screen inverted base channel
objects.definition: A downward-opening or inverted screen base channel positioned over the level-threshold waterstop to locate the shower screen while allowing the waterstop and membrane termination to remain continuous below it.
functions: Mount or locate the shower screen
Define the shower boundary
Cover and coordinate with the waterstop without breaching it improperly

cad.pattern: Continuous channel along framed shower-screen base
cad.placement: Directly over the shower waterstop
cad.load: Supports or locates screen according to product

objects.name: wet-area penetration seal
objects.definition: A compatible waterproof seal formed around a tap, spout, shower outlet, pipe, fixing or other penetration through a protected wet-area wall or floor surface.
functions: Stop water passing around the penetration
Connect the penetrating item to membrane or water-resistant surface
Allow required fitting maintenance where applicable

ncc_references.relationship: Penetrations and mechanical fixing holes in shower protection are waterproofed with sealants, proprietary flanges or both.

cad.pattern: One sealed annulus or shaped patch per penetration
cad.placement: At the protected-surface crossing
cad.load: Non-structural waterproof seal

objects.name: wet-area proprietary penetration flange
objects.definition: A purpose-made rigid or flexible flanged fitting installed around a tap body, pipe or outlet so membrane or sealant can bond to a broad controlled surface around the penetration.
functions: Provide a reliable membrane bonding flange
Locate and seal the penetration
Accommodate fitting shape or movement as documented

cad.pattern: Discrete flange centred on penetration
cad.placement: Bonded or fixed into protected surface
cad.load: Supports seal rather than service loads unless documented

objects.name: wet-area fastener penetration seal
objects.definition: A local waterproof treatment around a mechanical fixing that passes through a wet-area membrane, protected substrate or surface finish.
functions: Seal the fastener hole
Maintain membrane continuity
Protect the substrate behind mounted fittings

cad.pattern: Local annular seal at each through-membrane fixing
cad.placement: Between fastener and protected layers
cad.load: Fixing load carried separately from waterproof seal

objects.name: wet-area floor waste assembly
objects.definition: A floor-level drainage fitting that collects surface water from a wet area and connects it through a grate, body, flange and riser or trap arrangement to the sanitary drainage system.
functions: Receive water from floor falls
Connect surface and membrane drainage to pipework
Provide a removable grate and accessible inlet

cad.pattern: One drain assembly at each scheduled floor low point
cad.placement: Recessed into wet-area floor build-up
cad.load: Grate carries local foot traffic; body supported by floor and pipework

notes: Whether a floor waste is required and whether it is a trapped gully are plumbing and jurisdiction questions; the ontology records the physical assembly without deciding them.

objects.name: floor-waste grate
objects.definition: A removable perforated, slotted or tile-insert cover at the top of a floor waste that admits water while providing a walkable surface and access to the drain body.
functions: Admit surface water
Bridge the drain opening for foot traffic
Allow cleaning access

cad.pattern: Discrete top cover centred on floor waste
cad.placement: Flush with finished floor
cad.load: Supports local foot load across drain opening

objects.name: floor-waste body
objects.definition: The recessed body beneath a floor-waste grate that forms the inlet throat, receives height adjustment or flange components and directs collected water to its outlet or riser.
functions: Collect water beneath the grate
Connect grate level to outlet pipe
Receive compatible membrane and tile-bed drainage components

cad.pattern: Recessed cup, barrel or throat below grate
cad.placement: Within floor build-up
cad.load: Supported by substrate, flange and pipe connection

objects.name: wet-area drainage flange
objects.definition: A broad annular or rectangular flange at a floor drain that provides the prepared horizontal surface or clamping form to which the waterproof membrane is continuously sealed.
functions: Join membrane to the drain
Spread the waterproof connection around the inlet
Allow membrane-level water to reach the drainage path

cad.pattern: Broad flange surrounding drain throat
cad.placement: At membrane level within floor build-up
cad.load: Supports waterproof junction and local build-up

objects.name: puddle flange floor-waste fitting
objects.definition: A proprietary drainage-flange fitting commonly used in Australian wet areas, formed around a waste riser or drain body to provide a membrane bond area and a path for water at membrane or tile-bed level.
functions: Seal membrane around a waste
Connect the drain to surrounding floor build-up
Collect incidental water reaching the flange level
not_synonyms: pipe puddle flange through a concrete wall

cad.pattern: Discrete flanged fitting concentric with waste riser
cad.placement: Recessed or cast at floor waste
cad.load: Supports membrane junction

notes: Puddle flange also has other construction meanings; this object is specifically the internal wet-area floor-waste fitting.

objects.name: wet-area drainage riser
objects.definition: The generally vertical pipe section rising through the floor build-up to connect a shower base, floor-waste body or membrane drainage fitting to the sanitary drainage system below.
functions: Carry wastewater downward
Provide a connection to the tray or drainage flange
Set the drain position through the floor
materials: copper or compatible sanitary pipe material

cad.pattern: Vertical pipe segment below each wet-area drain
cad.placement: Through structural floor and floor build-up
cad.load: Pipe supported by plumbing system and floor interface

notes: The full sanitary drainage network will be expanded in the plumbing discipline; this record captures the wet-area interface now.

objects.name: linear wet-area floor drain assembly
objects.definition: A long narrow drain comprising a channel, grate or tile insert, outlet, membrane flange and support, used as a line low point across or along a shower or wet-area floor.
functions: Collect water along a line
Simplify adjacent fall planes
Connect the membrane and tile bed to a drainage outlet

cad.pattern: Continuous drain line at edge or across floor field
cad.placement: At a linear low point in floor build-up
cad.load: Grate spans channel; body supported by floor

notes: Exact hydraulic capacity, trap connection and membrane flange are selected product data.

objects.name: linear floor-drain channel
objects.definition: The long trough body of a linear floor drain that receives water through its grate or tile-insert gap and conveys it to one or more outlets.
functions: Collect water along the drain length
Carry water to the outlet
Support the grate or tile insert

cad.pattern: One elongated trough
cad.placement: Below finished-floor grate line
cad.load: Supports grate and conveys water

objects.name: preformed shower base unit
objects.definition: The factory-formed tray body that provides the finished or tile-ready shower floor, integral falls, waste opening and perimeter upturns before connection to walls, support and drainage.
functions: Form shower-floor vessel
Collect and direct water
Provide factory-formed upturns and outlet opening

cad.pattern: One moulded or fabricated tray body
cad.placement: Within shower base assembly
cad.load: Carries occupant load to support bed or points

objects.name: shower-base, bath or spa upturn lip
objects.definition: An integral raised edge on a preformed shower base, inserted bath or spa that sits behind wall substrate and surface materials so water at the vessel perimeter is directed back inside.
functions: Stop water passing behind the vessel
Receive overlapping wall substrate and finish
Form a continuous perimeter or wall-side upstand

cad.pattern: Integral raised flange around selected vessel edges
cad.placement: Behind adjacent wall substrate and finish
cad.opening: May omit access threshold edge according to product
cad.load: Integral water-control edge

objects.name: preformed shower-base support bed or frame
objects.definition: The mortar bed, foam cradle, feet, frame or other documented support beneath a preformed shower base that prevents flexing, distortion and cracking under use.
functions: Support the shower base
Transfer occupant and water loads
Maintain drain and perimeter geometry

cad.pattern: Continuous bed or repeated supports beneath tray
cad.placement: Between shower-base unit and structural floor
cad.load: Transfers tray loads to floor

objects.name: bath or spa vessel
objects.definition: A water-holding sanitary fixture for bathing, supplied as a freestanding, wall-abutting or inserted vessel with its own rim or lip, waste and overflow openings and support requirements.
functions: Hold bathing water
Provide a drained bathing fixture
Interface with wet-area walls, floors, taps and supports

cad.pattern: One sanitary vessel
cad.placement: On floor supports or within surround
cad.opening: Contains waste, overflow and optional tap holes
cad.load: Water and occupant loads carried by documented supports

notes: Detailed taps, wastes and sanitary plumbing will be expanded in the plumbing slice.

objects.name: inserted-bath waterproof shelf
objects.definition: The horizontal ledge or deck between an inserted bath or spa lip and its surrounding walls, formed from supported substrate and waterproofed into the vessel waterstop before finishing.
functions: Close the surround around the vessel
Provide a waterproof horizontal surface
Support tiles and tap penetrations where designed

cad.pattern: Horizontal surface following vessel perimeter
cad.placement: Between inserted vessel lip and surround walls
cad.opening: Cut and sealed around taps and access
cad.load: Supports finish and minor use loads through surround framing

objects.name: wet-area wall niche assembly
objects.definition: A framed or preformed recessed box within a wet-area wall whose back, sides, sill, corners and perimeter are integrated with the wall substrate, membrane and tiled or sheet finish.
functions: Provide recessed storage
Maintain waterproof wall continuity through the recess
Drain its lower surface back toward the wet area

cad.pattern: Box recess within protected wall field
cad.placement: Between wall studs or within solid-wall recess
cad.load: Niche and contents supported by wall framing

objects.name: wet-area wall tile
objects.definition: A ceramic, porcelain, glass, natural-stone or reconstituted-stone unit bonded to a prepared wet-area wall substrate or compatible membrane as part of the water-resistant surface finish.
functions: Provide a cleanable wall finish
Protect the substrate from direct splash
Form a repeatable jointed surface around fixtures and corners

cad.pattern: Repeated tile grid over protected wall field
cad.placement: Bonded to compatible substrate or membrane
cad.load: Tile weight carried through adhesive

objects.name: wet-area floor tile
objects.definition: A ceramic, porcelain, glass, natural-stone or reconstituted-stone unit bonded over a wet-area floor substrate, screed or membrane and laid to follow the designed fall planes and drain geometry.
functions: Provide a durable walking finish
Follow drainage falls
Protect underlying layers from normal traffic

cad.pattern: Repeated tile grid split and cut to follow floor planes
cad.placement: Bonded over compatible floor build-up
cad.load: Foot traffic transferred through adhesive and substrate

notes: Large tiles can conflict with multi-directional falls around a point drain; the tool should expose the geometry clash rather than silently warp tiles.

objects.name: wet-area mosaic tile sheet
objects.definition: A factory-assembled sheet of many small tile units held in a regular pattern by mesh, paper or another carrier for installation across curved or multi-plane wet-area surfaces.
functions: Place many small tiles efficiently
Conform more readily to floor falls and curves
Maintain repeated joint spacing

cad.pattern: Nested small-tile grid grouped into placement sheets
cad.placement: On wet-area wall or floor surface
cad.load: Finish bonded through adhesive

objects.name: wet-area tile adhesive
objects.definition: A compatible cementitious, dispersion or reaction-resin bonding material spread between wet-area tiles and their prepared substrate or membrane.
functions: Bond tiles to the receiving surface
Transfer tile loads
Accommodate the documented substrate, membrane and service exposure

cad.pattern: Continuous or combed bedding layer behind each tile field
cad.placement: Between tile and compatible receiving surface
cad.opening: Maintains coverage around cuts without blocking joints
cad.load: Transfers tile loads to substrate

objects.name: wet-area tile grout
objects.definition: A cementitious or reaction-resin material packed into the regular joints between installed wet-area tiles, finished flush or profiled to protect tile edges and create a cleanable surface.
functions: Fill tile joints
Protect and visually finish tile edges
Allow cleaning of the tiled surface

cad.pattern: Repeated narrow joints between tiles
cad.placement: Within tile grid excluding flexible joints
cad.opening: Fills tile gap without replacing movement joints
cad.load: Non-structural joint finish

notes: Ordinary grout is not treated as the primary waterproof layer.

objects.name: flexible wet-area tile sealant joint
objects.definition: A flexible sealant joint replacing rigid grout at selected changes of plane, perimeters, fixture interfaces or movement locations in a wet-area tile finish.
functions: Seal selected tile junctions
Accommodate movement
Keep water and debris out of the finish joint
materials: polyurethane or other compatible flexible sealant

cad.pattern: Continuous flexible lines at selected tile boundaries
cad.placement: Between tiles, fixtures, trims or adjoining finishes
cad.load: Flexible finish seal

objects.name: wet-area tile movement-joint assembly
objects.definition: A deliberate continuous break through the tiled finish and relevant bedding or adhesive layers, containing a clear movement zone, backing or bond breaker and flexible seal or proprietary profile aligned with the required substrate movement detail.
functions: Allow tiled fields to move
Prevent rigid bridging of substrate joints
Seal the visible movement gap

cad.pattern: Continuous gap through tiled finish at scheduled lines
cad.placement: At perimeters, field divisions and substrate movement joints
cad.opening: Preserves movement gap through finish layers
cad.load: Movement accommodation, not load transfer across gap unless profile provides it

objects.name: wet-area tile edge trim
objects.definition: A linear metal, plastic, ceramic or stone profile that protects and finishes an exposed tile edge, external corner, floor transition or termination without replacing the waterproofing detail behind it.
functions: Protect exposed tile edges
Provide a straight visible termination
Coordinate finish thickness and adjoining surfaces

cad.pattern: Continuous profile along exposed tile edge
cad.placement: Embedded beneath tile edge in adhesive
cad.opening: Finishes edge without sealing hidden junction alone
cad.load: Protective finish fitting

objects.name: thermosetting laminate wet-area wall lining
objects.definition: A rigid resin-impregnated decorative laminate fixed or bonded over a suitable wet-area wall substrate as a water-resistant surface, with edges, joints and penetrations sealed by the selected system.
functions: Provide a cleanable wall surface
Resist splash as part of a water-resistant system
Cover the prepared wall substrate

cad.pattern: Large wall sheets with sealed joints
cad.placement: On suitable wet-area wall substrate
cad.load: Finish bonded or fixed to substrate

objects.name: pre-decorated compressed fibre-cement wet-area sheet
objects.definition: A compressed fibre-cement sheet supplied with a durable decorative face and installed as both wet-area wall substrate and exposed water-resistant finish with sealed joints and penetrations.
functions: Line the wall
Provide a finished cleanable surface
Form part of a water-resistant wall system

cad.pattern: Large finished sheets on wall supports
cad.placement: On wall framing or suitable background
cad.load: Sheet and finish loads transferred to support

objects.name: sanitary-grade acrylic wet-area lining
objects.definition: A formed or flat sanitary-grade acrylic panel installed as a cleanable water-resistant wall surface around a shower, bath or other vessel, with sealed joints and fixture penetrations.
functions: Provide a smooth cleanable wall finish
Resist splash as part of a wet-area system
Form corners and vessel returns with few joints

cad.pattern: Large flat or formed wall panels
cad.placement: On suitable wet-area substrate around vessel
cad.opening: Factory or site cut around fixtures and sealed
cad.load: Panel bonded or fixed to substrate

objects.name: water-resistant flexible sheet wall finish
objects.definition: A flexible sheet wall finish installed over a suitable wet-area substrate with sealed joints so the combined construction forms a water-resistant surface.
functions: Provide a cleanable flexible wall finish
Cover the substrate with few seams
Form a sealed surface around junctions and penetrations
materials: vinyl or other water-resistant flexible sheet

cad.pattern: Roll-width wall sheets with sealed seams
cad.placement: On suitable wet-area wall substrate
cad.load: Finish adhered to substrate

objects.name: water-resistant flexible sheet wet-area flooring
objects.definition: A flexible sheet floor finish laid over a suitable wet-area floor substrate with sealed joints, providing a water-resistant surface where a fully waterproof sheet-flooring system is not required by the selected path.
functions: Provide a cleanable walking finish
Resist routine wet-area splash
Follow floor falls and sealed perimeter details
materials: rubber or other documented sheet finish

cad.pattern: Roll-width floor sheets with sealed seams
cad.placement: On suitable floor substrate
cad.load: Walking finish adhered to substrate

notes: The Housing Provisions separately name waterproof and water-resistant flexible sheet flooring; a product must not be assigned to the stronger class from appearance.

objects.name: stainless-steel wet-area waterproof surface
objects.definition: A formed or sheet stainless-steel surface used as a waterproof wet-area lining, tray, bench or junction component with welded, folded or sealed edges and penetrations.
functions: Provide an intrinsically waterproof surface
Form durable trays and linings
Join to drains, upstands and adjacent protection

cad.pattern: Formed sheet field with folded upstands and welded joints
cad.placement: As exposed lining, tray or junction surface
cad.load: Sheet supported by substrate or fabricated frame
